description: Reference: GTWW-T1353. The building features a striking architecture, inspired by the universe of high jewellery, which is reflected in sculptural shapes, metal inserts, worked decorative elements and meticulous attention to every aesthetic detail. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. The tower also has concierge services available daily, valet assistance, permanent security staff, high-standard reception and advanced access control systems. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. The location in Business Bay guarantees a privileged connection to strategic areas of Dubai, such as Downtown, Dubai Canal, financial centres, cultural areas and some of the city's most popular gastronomic and commercial destinations. The proximity to the main traffic routes offers quick accessibility to the airport, beaches and other central neighbourhoods, making the development an ideal option for both permanent residence and investment. Taken together, this tower represents a unique proposition in Dubai's real estate landscape: it combines extremely refined design, typologies adapted to different lifestyles, international standard services and a highly prestigious location. title: Dubayy, Dubai
description: Reference: YHKN-T13222. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." The project comprises two towers of contrasting heights rising above a shared podium base, with a sculptural, fluid silhouette. Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. The development is positioned as a contemporary residential and commercial destination, complemented by panoramic city views. Residents have access to a dedicated pool for adults and children, together with a yoga and aerobics platform and a paddle and tennis court for active pursuits. A children's play area sits alongside family sitting and social nooks, while wellness facilities and lounge sitting platforms provide space for relaxation. The development also includes an open lawn, a dedicated jogging and sprint lane, and activity tables with a ping-pong table for recreation. Interior layouts range from efficient studios to expansive three-bedroom residences, with the largest configurations featuring a private pool and a terrace open to the sky, plus dedicated laundry space. Rooms are organized around distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites in the larger units. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, and are delivered unfurnished. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Emaar Ocean Star
description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.
The development includes 154 residential apartments, comprising 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom homes. The apartments feature practical layouts, spacious living areas and private balconies or terraces, with a range of configurations to suit different household needs. The supplied floor plans cover 38 layout variations, with total apartment areas ranging from approximately 789.9 to 2,025 sq ft.
One-bedroom apartments offer efficient layouts with private outdoor space, while two-bedroom residences provide additional room for families and shared living. Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. The combination of indoor living space and private outdoor areas contributes to the development's residential appeal.
Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

description: Discover a home where every view inspires and every moment brings you closer to nature. Framed by floor-to-ceiling windows and sweeping vistas of lush green fairways, these residences offer more than beautiful surroundings-they create a setting where everyday living feels extraordinary. With the championship-style landscape of the 18-hole Emaar South Golf Course as a backdrop, residents can enjoy a lifestyle defined by open horizons, natural beauty, and peaceful sophistication. Wake up to rolling greens, enjoy morning walks along scenic pathways, or unwind with sunset strolls through landscaped parks. The seamless connection between indoor comfort and the outdoors creates an atmosphere of tranquillity, offering a refreshing escape from the pace of city life. Here, golf-inspired living meets the simple pleasures of nature. The architecture embraces contemporary elegance through thoughtful proportions, natural textures, and a warm, earthy colour palette. Floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light into the interiors, while secluded alcoves provide peaceful spaces for relaxation. The collection features one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, alongside exclusive three-bedroom townhouses, with spacious layouts and captivating views of the surrounding golf course. Finishing and Materials The interiors feature a calming palette inspired by nature, combining earthy tones with carefully selected materials to create a warm and inviting atmosphere. Furnishing The residences are unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalise their interiors according to their individual tastes and preferences. Offering a diverse selection of apartments, townhouses, and villas, the community caters to a variety of lifestyles while embracing a modern approach to comfortable living. Green spaces, landscaped parks, and outdoor recreational areas contribute to a peaceful community atmosphere, providing residents with opportunities to walk, relax, and spend time outdoors. A range of lifestyle facilities, including swimming pools, fitness amenities, sports facilities, and community spaces, supports an active and well-balanced way of life. The community's location near Al Maktoum International Airport and the Expo City Dubai area adds to its long-term appeal for residents, frequent travellers, and professionals. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Dubai
description: Elegantly Designed Apartments with Installment Plans in Dubai Studio City Dubai Studio City is a vibrant hub designed to cater to the dynamic lifestyle of modern residents and professionals. Renowned for its thriving media and entertainment sector, the community offers a unique blend of residential, commercial, and recreational spaces. Featuring contemporary architecture and world-class infrastructure, Dubai Studio City is home to a range of premium apartments, state-of-the-art facilities, and lush green spaces. Its strategic location provides seamless connectivity to major areas of Dubai, making it an ideal choice for those seeking convenience and sophistication. With its focus on innovation and creativity, Dubai Studio City continues to attract residents and businesses looking for a dynamic and inspiring environment. Apartments in Dubai Studio City, are strategically located, just 5 minutes from GEMS Metropole School, 9 minutes from Butterfly Garden and Miracle Garden, 10 minutes from Dubai Autodrome, 15 minutes from Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, 20 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport, 25 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 33 minutes from JBR and Dubai Marina. The project is a harmonious blend of nature-inspired design and modern urban living, crafted with inspiration from the traditional Arabic Arisha. It features four low-rise buildings with 419 meticulously designed apartments, each offering spacious balconies or terraces to embrace outdoor living. Spanning over 64,000 sq. ft., the amenities include adult and kids swimming pools, a rooftop hydroponic garden, solar panels for sustainability, a smart home system, and drinkable tap water. Residents can enjoy a fully equipped gym, yoga studio, sauna, steam rooms, and a rooftop padel court. The community center offers a cinema, co-working space, library, and shared kitchen, along with outdoor BBQ zones and firepits. Additional features include high ceilings, modern finishes, retail outlets, indoor and outdoor childrens play areas, and dedicated parking spaces. Lush greenery throughout the development enhances its serene ambiance, making it a haven of refined and sustainable living. The project offers an elegant selection of studio, one-, and two-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to blend functionality with sophistication. Interiors feature modern finishes, high ceilings, and large windows that invite natural light, creating a spacious and welcoming ambiance. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and built-in Bosch kitchen appliances, ensuring a seamless and comfortable living experience. The apartments come with private balconies or terraces that extend the living space outdoors, enhancing the connection with nature. Designed for contemporary lifestyles, these homes provide a perfect balance of comfort and practicality, catering to diverse preferences and needs. DXB-00190

This architectural wonder not only attracts attention with its unique design but also serves as a vibrant cultural and artistic center. It is a popular nightlife destination offering a variety of dining options. The apartments for sale in Dubai are within a 5-minute walk from major attractions such as Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera, Business Bay, and Dubai Water Canal. They are also 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport and 30 minutes from Palm Jumeirah and Marina area. Opus is designed as two separate towers that coalesce into a single whole, taking the shape of a cube. The cube is then ''carved'' to create a central void within the building, which is an important volume in its own right and provides a view from the center of the building to the exterior. The two towers are linked by a four-story atrium at ground level with a bridge connecting 71 meters above the ground. The bridge is constructed with double-curved glass, double-curved aluminum frames, and steel elements. The bridge consists of three storeys offering spectacular views and the feeling of being at the top. The 96 units in Opus are available in a range of sizes, from one and two-bedroom apartments to exceptional duplexes and triplexes. They all have full access to hotel facilities and spectacular amenities. On your doorstep, you will find an eclectic variety of innovative food and beverage experiences, cultural events, and artistic performances. The project offers luxury services such as 24/7 security and valet services, secured basement parking, valet parking service for visitors, house cleaning service, laundry services, special discounts on food, beverage, and entertainment facilities, and in-home catering. description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

description: Ready to Move Apartments with Post-Handover Installments in Business Bay Business Bay is one of Dubai's most prestigious and dynamic neighborhoods, known for its sleek skyscrapers, vibrant lifestyle, and proximity to major landmarks like Downtown Dubai and the Burj Khalifa. Situated along the Dubai Canal, it offers a perfect blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, making it a top choice for professionals and families alike. With world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options just minutes away, Business Bay continues to grow as a prime destination for modern urban living and investment. , are strategically located just 5 minutes from Marasi Promenade, 9 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 10 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 11 minutes from Dubai Opera, 11 minutes from Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The project features a distinctive architectural design tilted at a 6.5 angle and fully enveloped in dynamic LED lighting, creating a shimmering facade by day and a vibrant light show by night. Located in Marasi Business Bay, it offers residents stunning views of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Creek, and Downtown Dubai. The exterior is complemented by lush landscaped gardens and a glittering swimming pool area with cabanas and a tanning deck, all designed to provide a private oasis above the city. Residents can enjoy a range of premium amenities, including a fully-equipped, view-facing gym with the latest in fitness technology and personal training facilities, a sensory-driven lobby with an immersive video wall that mirrors Dubai's natural beauty throughout the day, and state-of-the-art smart home automation systems for full control of lighting, climate, entertainment, and more. The development also includes vibrant retail outlets featuring luxury brands and boutique designers, a gourmet selection of dining options including a chocolate bar, coffee shop, and fusion restaurant, as well as chic communal areas for socializing and relaxation. The project presents a collection of exquisitely furnished studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences, thoughtfully designed with a modern and vibrant aesthetic that merges comfort, luxury, and technology. Each unit features floor-to-ceiling windows that frame panoramic views of Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, and Dubai Creek, enhancing the feeling of open space and natural light. Interiors are characterized by sleek surfaces, glamorous contemporary furniture, inspirational artwork, and a dynamic color palette that reflects a chic, South Beach-inspired vibe. Every apartment is equipped with fitted wardrobes and premium kitchen white goods, delivering both style and functionality. Advanced smart home automation is seamlessly integrated, allowing residents to control lighting, climate, blinds, multimedia, and even guest parking from touch panels or a mobile app. Bathrooms include elegant finishes and mood lighting, while the overall design emphasizes energy, flow, and a joyful, balanced lifestyle within a sophisticated urban sanctuary. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. Contact: Mayank

description: Reference: UAJM-T3278. 1 Bed Apartment for Sale in Nama 3 Complex Sharjah UAE Esales Property ID: es5554971 Al Mamsha Alef - Muwaileh Commercial - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates AED 800,000 Luxury Living Reimagined: Premium 1-Bedroom Apartment in Nama 3, Sharjah Discover the epitome of modern urban living with this exquisite 1-bedroom apartment for sale in the Nama 3 Complex, a prestigious residential landmark currently rising in the heart of the Emirate of Sharjah. Positioned within the highly anticipated Al Mamsha Raseel development, Nama 3 represents a sophisticated blend of contemporary architecture, high-end finishing, and an unparalleled lifestyle proposition. For those seeking an investment or a home in one of the UAE's most forward-thinking districts, this property offers a unique entry point into a vibrant, future-proof community. The Concept: Sharjah's Premier Walkable Community Nama 3 is located within Zone 3 of Al Mamsha Raseel, a visionary project designed by the Alef Group. This district is celebrated as the first fully integrated walkable community in Sharjah. The design philosophy centers on a 'car-free' environment at the ground level, prioritizing pedestrian safety, air quality, and social interaction. Imagine stepping out of your luxury tower directly onto beautifully landscaped walkways, where high-end retail stores, artisanal cafes, and essential services are all within a few minutes' stroll. This layout creates a harmonious balance between the privacy of residential life and the energy of a bustling commercial hub. A Strategic Masterplan: Al Mamsha Raseel The Al Mamsha Raseel sector is strategically nestled along the E311 (Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road), the primary artery connecting the various Emirates. This zone does not exist in isolation; it is seamlessly abutted by two other distinct districts: Al Mamsha Souks and Al Mamsha Seerah. description: Raw District is a premium mixed-use development. Conceived as an "urban lifestyle philosophy" rather than a conventional residential project, the development is designed as a dynamic cultural hub where living, working, and social interaction seamlessly intersect. Its architecture embraces a raw, minimalistic aesthetic with open, adaptable spaces that prioritize functionality, movement, and continuous evolution.The project offers a wide range of fully furnished residences, including studios, 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, alongside office and retail spaces. Raw District stands out for its extensive and unconventional amenities, curated to foster creativity, collaboration, and community engagement. Rather than traditional leisure facilities, the project introduces concept-driven spaces such as creative studios, podcast rooms, co-working hubs, wellness zones, indoor and outdoor cinemas, and curated dining experiences. Signature features like the District Table, design labs, and maker spaces create an ecosystem where residents and professionals can connect, create, and evolve - forming a vibrant, ever-changing environment tailored to a new generation of urban living. Interiors follow a clean, stripped-back design language focused on efficiency and comfort, featuring open-plan kitchens, integrated appliances, smart storage solutions, and smart home technology. The layouts are thoughtfully designed to support modern urban lifestyles, balancing practicality with understated elegance. A strong emphasis is placed on furnishing and interior detailing, with residences delivered fully furnished in a refined, minimalist style that prioritizes clarity, usability, and quiet sophistication. Additional features such as acoustic treatments, smart home integration, and high-quality fittings further elevate everyday living, ensuring each space feels cohesive, functional, and effortlessly livable. Location description and benefits Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's largest container hubs, which has cemented the area's global significance in trade and commerce. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.

Travel Hubs: Global connectivity is a breeze. Why Invest in Nama 3? As Sharjah continues to grow as a cultural and economic powerhouse, properties within integrated communities like Al Mamsha Raseel are expected to see significant capital appreciation and high rental yields. description:
DIFC Heights Tower is the second residential development from Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), following DIFC Living. The mixed-use tower stands on Al Mostaqbal Street in DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre), between Index Tower and DAMAC Park Towers, and rises to ground plus 47 floors, with 32 residential floors and seven commercial floors. Its 366 homes range from one-bedroom apartments of 871 sq ft to four-bedroom duplexes of 3,618 sq ft, with two- and three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom duplexes in between.

Interiors use pastel tones, high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glazing, and the homes are semi-furnished, with Bosch kitchen appliances in the apartments and Miele in the duplexes. Shared facilities include a gym, a temperature-controlled swimming pool, a separate kids' pool, a family lounge, an indoor kids' play area, a multipurpose hall and a co-working space, alongside landscaped terraces at the podium and amenity levels. The tower opens onto Gate Avenue at both ground and podium level, a Dubai Metro station is about five minutes on foot, Burj Khalifa and the Museum of the Future are around five minutes by car, and Dubai International Airport is roughly 20 minutes away.

DIFC is home to more than 46,000 professionals working across over 6,900 registered companies, so the homes sit close to a large and established workforce. The developer is the financial centre itself, and the building combines residences with offices and retail in a single address. The payment plan is 5% on booking, 65% during construction and 30% on handover, with completion expected in Q4 2029.

description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways.
